description: Systematic URL rewrites applied to harvested content. Read by both scripts/verify_content.py (link integrity check + --write-fixes) and scripts/harvest_osgeo.py (post-conversion rewrite). The registry is the persistent memory of every fix we have made on top of the upstream content: re-harvests apply it again so fixes are never silently lost. Fixes are tried in order; the first matching pattern wins.

fixes.reason: OSGeo wiki migrated from MediaWiki default URLs (/index.php/X) to pretty URLs (/wiki/X); the old paths now 404.
OSGeo subdomains all 301-redirect HTTP to HTTPS; promote the link so browsers do not need the extra hop.

html2text often inserts backslash-escapes for parens inside angle-bracket URLs (e.g. <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/501\(c\)_organization>) where escaping is neither needed nor honoured by browsers. Remove the bogus backslashes so the URL resolves.
